sources.text: Third rule: copy Priya Raman from the refunds team on every escalation.
And never promise a customer a delivery date in writing.
For anything stuck at a carrier depot, Tomasz Brennan in the warehouse issues the release.
Tomasz Brennan: He's off tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, so release requests have to reach him today.
Their buyer is Sigrid Halvorsen.
Sigrid Halvorsen: She only takes calls after 2 pm, on her direct line at extension 4127.
Tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, Marcus is at the supplier summit.
Until 2026-10-09, Ruth Adeyemi, our deputy manager, gives any sign-off that would normally need Marcus.
While ESC-2219 is open, phone Freightline's Riverside desk at 555-0188 every morning for a status on the Halvorsen lights.
Copperline's buyer is Owen Pritchard.
Grace Okafor emailed again about her duvet.
Parcelway has no answer on TR-3307 yet, so if nothing turns up by the end of the day we send her replacement.
Small fix on Copperline: Owen's extension is 4310, not 4301.
The before-noon window stands.
Chase Parcelway every afternoon on Farah's redirect until the curtains land.
Disregard yesterday's note about the Saturday walk-in returns counter: facilities closed it all day for floor work, so walk-in returns wait until Monday.
Dalia Moreno, account LH-66208, left a voicemail asking for a call back on 555-0175 to book a delivery slot for her sofa, order LH-86610.
